title: Silesian Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Silesian Wars", at revision 1370746920, opens: "The Silesian Wars were three wars fought in the mid-18th century between Prussia, under King Frederick the Great, and Habsburg Austria, under Empress Maria Theresa, for control of the Central European region of Silesia, now in south-western Poland." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q699849, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "three conflicts between the Kingdom of Prussia and the Austrian Habsburg Monarchy for control of Silesia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
